async def act(page):
    # Set Period to 'Month' for monthly report
    await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Period').select_option('Month')
    # Set From date to 2023-02-01 (start of February 2023)
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='From *').fill('2023-02-01')
    # Set To date to 2023-02-28 (end of February 2023)
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='To *').fill('2023-02-28')
    # Click the 'Show Report' button to generate the report
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Show Report').click()
    # Wait for the report to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
